usage: __main__.py [-h] {start,stop,event,export,inspect} ...

Passive capture CLI: start, stop, event, export, inspect. Never launches
hardware.

  {start,stop,event,export,inspect}

options:

usage: replay.py [-h] --root ROOT [--manifest MANIFEST]
                 [--camera-id {high,low}]
                 [--dataset-role {synthetic,static,visual_sequence,unknown}]
                 --output OUTPUT

Replay image directories or frozen-contract camera_frame JSONL; offline only.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           image/session root
  --manifest MANIFEST   camera_frame-only JSONL
  --camera-id {high,low}
                        required for directory input
  --dataset-role {synthetic,static,visual_sequence,unknown}
  --output OUTPUT       new directory; existing path rejected
